title: Challenges Facing Agritourism: How Are Producers Coping?
Heterogeneous Flood Zone Effects on Coastal Housing Prices - Risk Signal and Mandatory Costs
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Using a high-quality dataset and addressing various empirical challenges, we estimate the heterogeneous impact of flood zone on single-family housing prices in coastal Connecticut. Causal forest estimates suggest that transactions without a mortgage loan, where flood insurance is voluntary, show an insignificantly positive average flood zone effect. Conversely, with mandatory and upfront insurance costs, with-loan transactions exhibit a significant average discount of $8k. To detect the nuanced risk signals associated with the flood zone designation and mandatory costs, we conceptualize and empirically test differences in distributions of heterogeneous flood zone effects between transactions with and without mortgage. We find that mandatory insurance concentrates the flood zone effects within the capitalization range of insurance costs but does not significantly increase discounts beyond full capitalization. Robust evidence suggests that most transactions feature minimal flood zone discounts, if any, suggesting neither the flood zone designation nor the mandatory flood insurance conveys a sufficiently strong message about rising flood risks. Despite heightened risk perceptions from recent hurricanes and policies, stronger flood risk signaling is needed in coastal Connecticut.
abstract_zh: 利用高质量数据集并应对各种实证挑战，我们估计了洪泛区对康涅狄格州沿海单户住房价格的异质性影响。因果森林估计表明，无抵押贷款的交易（洪水保险为自愿购买）显示出统计上不显著为正的平均洪泛区效应。相反，对于有抵押贷款的交易，由于存在强制且需预付的保险成本，则表现出8,000美元的显著平均折价。为识别与洪泛区划定和强制性成本相关的细微风险信号，我们提出并实证检验了有抵押与无抵押交易之间异质性洪泛区效应分布的差异。我们发现，强制保险使洪泛区效应集中于保险成本的资本化范围之内，但并未显著增加超出完全资本化的折价。稳健的证据表明，大多数交易即便存在洪泛区折价，也极为微小，这表明无论是洪泛区划定还是强制性洪水保险，都未能传递出足够强烈的关于日益增长的洪水风险的信号。尽管近期飓风和政策提升了风险认知，康涅狄格州沿海地区仍需更强有力的洪水风险信号。

Pricing Coastal Amenities and Flood Hazards
abstract: Coastlines bring a basket of precious amenities to residents but also have significant and growing risks from storms and rising sea levels. Disentangling these amenities and risks is of everincreasing importance to the public and policymakers. Evaluating the most tangible aspect of coastal living in New England, we present a scalable way to construct parcel-specific measures of coastal amenities. Estimates suggest that good coastal amenities, represented by unobstructed ocean views, add about 33% to 69% to property prices. Coastal hazard effects are separated from the amenities: the flood zone discounts in coastal Connecticut and Massachusetts are generally low.
abstract_zh: 海岸线为居民带来了诸多宝贵的舒适因素，但也伴随着来自风暴和海平面上升的重大且日益增长的风险。区分这些舒适因素与风险，对公众和政策制定者而言日益重要。在评估新英格兰沿海生活最具体的方面时，我们提出了一种可扩展的方法，用以构建地块层面的沿海舒适因素指标。估计表明，良好的沿海舒适因素（以无遮挡的海景为代表）会使房产价格上涨约33%至69%。将沿海灾害效应与舒适因素分离后，康涅狄格州和马萨诸塞州沿海的洪泛区折价总体较低。

Habitat Conservation in Agricultural Landscapes
venue: The Routledge Handbook of Agricultural Economics
abstract: Habitat conservation in agricultural landscapes has a long history in Canada and the United States. Two prominent policy tools utilized by both government and private conservation agencies are fee simple acquisitions and conservation easements to conserve habitat. Both conservation mechanisms are subject to many design and implementation challenges related to the private ownership of agricultural land. In this chapter, we focus on economic aspects of habitat conservation in agricultural landscapes in Canada and the U.S. We discuss the history of conservation programs in the two countries and survey the prior design and evaluation literatures. We conclude with a discussion of the current challenges and opportunities that newly available data sources present. JEL classifications: Q15, Q20
abstract_zh: 在加拿大和美国，农业景观中的栖息地保护已有悠久的历史。政府和私人保护机构广泛采用的两种主要政策工具是土地完全购买和保护地役权，以保护栖息地。由于农业用地为私人所有，这两种保护机制都面临许多设计和实施方面的挑战。在本章中，我们聚焦于加拿大和美国农业景观中栖息地保护的经济问题。我们讨论了两国保护计划的历史，并梳理了以往关于设计与评估的文献。最后，我们讨论了新近可获得的数据来源所带来的当前挑战与机遇。JEL分类：Q15, Q20

title: Exploiting spatial and temporal variations in residential subdivision development to identify urban growth spillovers
Free Riding, Upsizing, and Energy Efficiency Incentives in Maryland Homes
abstract: We use a unique dataset that combines an original survey of households, information about the structural characteristics of their homes, utility-provided electricity usage records and program participation status, to study the uptake of energy efficiency incentives and their effect on residential electricity consumption. Attention is restricted to homes where heating and cooling is provided exclusively by air-source heat pumps. We deploy a difference-in-difference study design and find that replacing a heat pump with a new one does reduce electricity usage by 8% on average. The effect differs dramatically across households based upon whether they receive an incentive towards the purchase of a new heat pump. Among incentive recipients, the effect is small, and the larger the incentive, the smaller the reduction in electricity usage. These findings suggest that capital costs are incorporated into the (long-term) cost of energy, generating an apparent rebound effect that is much more pronounced for incentive recipients.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个独特的数据集，将家庭原始调查、住宅结构特征、公用事业提供的用电记录以及项目参与状况相结合，研究能效激励的采纳及其对住宅用电的影响。分析仅限于供暖和制冷完全由空气源热泵提供的住宅。我们采用双重差分研究设计，发现用一台新热泵替换旧热泵平均可减少8%的用电量。效应因家庭是否获得购买新热泵的激励而有显著差异。在获得激励的家庭中，效应较小，且激励越大，用电量减少幅度越小。这些发现表明，资本成本被纳入（长期）能源成本之中，从而产生了一种明显的回弹效应，而这一效应在获得激励的家庭中更为突出。

Capitalized Costs of Habitat Conservation Easements
abstract: Perpetual conservation easements permanently remove the option to convert existing habitat to more intensive agricultural production. If existing habitat is at threat of conversion, removing the option to convert will reduce land values. In this article, we estimate the land value discount resulting from perpetual habitat conservation easements by using propensity score matching. We find that on the average eased parcel, land values fall by approximately $86 per acre for every acre of eased habitat. On average, our results suggest that landowners have been adequately compensated and conservation agencies have successfully secured habitat at risk of conversion.
abstract_zh: 永久性保护地役权永久性地取消了将现有栖息地转化为更集约农业生产的选项。如果现有栖息地面临被转化的威胁，取消转化选项将降低土地价值。在本文中，我们使用倾向得分匹配估计了永久性栖息地保护地役权所导致的土地价值折价。我们发现，平均而言，受地役权约束的地块每英亩受保护栖息地，土地价值下降约86美元。总体而言，我们的结果表明，土地所有者已获得充分补偿，保护机构也已成功保护了面临转化风险的栖息地。

An Empirical Examination of the Timing of Land Conversions in the Presence of Farmland Preservation Programs
abstract: Using a panel of parcel‐level data we estimate a hazard model and find strong evidence that the mere existence of an option to preserve farmland delays decisions to convert farmland to developed uses by about six years, a reduction in median conversion time of 12 to 43% depending on parcel size. Where such delays allow local governments to improve infrastructure or implement stricter growth control measures, benefits of a preservation option may be even more long term. Also, increases in the variance of returns to development tended to slow conversion for parcels with all but the highest lot capacities.
abstract_zh: 利用地块层面的面板数据，我们估计了一个风险模型，并发现有力证据表明，仅仅存在保护农田的选项，就能将农田转为开发用途的决定推迟约六年，使中位转换时间缩短12%至43%（取决于地块大小）。在这种推迟使地方政府得以改善基础设施或实施更严格的增长控制措施的情况下，保护选项的收益可能更具长期性。此外，开发回报方差的增加，在除最高地块容量之外的大多数地块上，减缓了转换速度。
